title: Wafer alignment detection
summary: I explored whether computer vision could spot misalignment in semiconductor wafer images. That meant collecting and labeling 560 microscope images, working around an uneven dataset, and training a YOLOv9 model. The model reached a reported F1 score of 0.95 on the project dataset, but only after over 30 different iterations with over 6000 total epochs of training. For a problem that is on such a microscopic scale, getting it this accurate required a whole lot of persistence. It was worth it though - just imagine how useful this could be.
